objective: Post-hoc remediation and bounded portfolio contract for rule and diagnostic ML momentum sleeves

sources.core_claim: Time-series momentum supports testing multiple bounded horizons.
sources.project_applicability: Motivates R0, R1, and the time-equivalent R3 horizon.
sources.reflection: R1-R3 reuse a visible historical window and are exploratory only.

sources.core_claim: Intraday timing effects can vary within the session.
sources.reflection: Current evidence cannot establish execution quality.

sources.core_claim: Intraday and overnight returns should not be conflated.
sources.project_applicability: Keep explicit overnight holding semantics in each sleeve.
sources.reflection: This portfolio does not add an overnight prediction model.

sources.core_claim: Risk scaling can change momentum drawdown characteristics.
sources.project_applicability: Use R3 as a bounded risk-adjusted comparator, not a proven champion.

sources.core_claim: Momentum can crash during sharp reversals.
sources.project_applicability: R2 tests bounded exit confirmation and minimum hold semantics.
sources.reflection: Hysteresis can also delay exits and increase losses.

sources.core_claim: Broad cross-sectional intraday strategies demand clean multi-symbol data.
sources.project_applicability: Keep this round to QQQ signal and TQQQ target.
sources.reflection: Do not expand to a stock basket.

sources.core_claim: Trading costs matter for high-turnover strategies.
sources.project_applicability: Charge turnover costs in historical and virtual Paper ledgers.
sources.reflection: Virtual costs are not observed fill TCA.

sources.core_claim: IEX feed coverage differs from SIP.
sources.project_applicability: Label all current data research-only and require a fresh completed session.
sources.reflection: No Alpaca multi-strategy orders are authorized.

candidate_matrix_revisions.reason: Bounded retrospective variants; historical window is not an untouched lockbox.
Both model families failed the validation gate.
